div.div:
The model stays on Hugging Face's servers.
Free up to a limit, then paid. One token gives you thousands of models — no hardware needed.

div.div:
The weights download to your machine.
No API cost and full data privacy — but it needs real hardware, and a small model can still bring a laptop to its knees.
